anchors.title: Alerts people trust
anchors.company_evidence: Northwind's engineering blog says on-call noise is the main thing slowing its forecasting team down.
anchors.job_connection: The role owns model reliability and alerting across the forecasting stack.
anchors.candidate_evidence: Rebuilt a monitoring pipeline around precision and cut false alerts by 30%.
anchors.anchor: Jane has already turned a noisy alerting setup into one the on-call team trusts, which is the problem this role exists to solve.

anchors.title: Research to production
anchors.company_evidence: Northwind ships its forecasting models from research notebooks to production every quarter.
anchors.job_connection: The role takes prototypes through testing, deployment and monitoring.
anchors.candidate_evidence: Took two anomaly-detection prototypes from notebook to a Dockerised service on AWS.
anchors.anchor: Jane has carried models across the gap from notebook to production, the path Northwind runs every quarter.

anchors.title: Small team, big surface
anchors.company_evidence: Northwind's ML platform team is four people supporting every product line.
anchors.job_connection: The role works across teams with little hand-holding.
anchors.candidate_evidence: Led a team of four that owned the data pipelines for three products.
anchors.anchor: Jane is used to a small team owning a wide surface, which is how Northwind's platform team works.
